notebook: Bulbasaur starts with Magical Leaf (40 PWR Grass sp STAB), giving huge early advantage vs early Rock/Water gyms.
Move Tutor upgrades tier 1 basic moves (40-50 PWR) directly to powerful tier 2 moves like Energy Ball, Thunderbolt, Surf, Aerial Ace.
Map 0 Gym (Brock) has Rock Pokemon Lv12 Geodude / Lv14 Onix; Grass/Water leads destroy him easily.
Map 1 Gym (Misty) is Water type; Grass/Electric leads (e.g. Ivysaur with Energy Ball) easily sweep her.
Pokecenter revives fainted Pokemon and restores the entire team to full HP; always visit before Gym battles if anyone is fainted or low.
Catching a Ground type like Marowak (Earthquake 100 PWR) or Diglett provides complete Electric immunity and sweeps Lt. Surge on Map 2.

Map 6 Gym (Blaine) is Fire type; high-level Water (Seaking with Wave Crash) and Ground (Marowak Earthquake) easily destroy him.
Map 7 Gym (Giovanni) is Ground type; Venusaur (Solar Beam Choice Specs) and Seaking (Wave Crash) easily defeat him.
Johto Map 0 Gym (Falkner) is Flying type; Rock/Electric/Ice moves or high-level fire/neutral attackers are needed.
Johto Map 1 Gym (Bugsy) is Bug type; Fire STAB (Charmeleon Flamethrower) or Flying moves easily sweep his team.
Johto Map 2 Gym (Whitney) is Normal type; high physical defense Rock types (Rhyhorn) resist Normal/Rollout, while strong STAB moves bring down Miltank.
Johto Map 3 Gym (Morty) is Ghost type; Normal types like Chansey are immune to Ghost, while high neutral STAB sweeps his frail Gengar/Haunter.
Johto Map 4 Gym (Chuck) is Fighting type (Poliwrath/Primeape); Psychic/Flying or high special bulk handles it.
Johto Map 5 Gym (Jasmine) is Steel type (Steelix/Magnemite); Fire (Charizard/Moltres) and Ground (Rhyperior Earthquake) dominate.
Johto Map 6 Gym (Pryce) is Ice type (Piloswine/Dewgong); Fire (Moltres Heat Wave Choice Specs), Rock and Electric destroy him.
Johto Map 7 Gym (Clair) is Dragon type (Kingdra/Dragonair); high neutral STAB (Choice Specs Fire/Electric/Earthquake) and bulky Normal tanks overcome her.
